description: Reviewed native Object selector contracts used to generate the capability-specific schema overlay. A resolved entry is authoritative for native operator tokens and literal value constraints; selectors not listed here remain explicitly unresolved and retain the generic baseline until their contract is reviewed.

operator_vocabulary.pattern_match_boundary: pattern_match is the 0.3 migration/source vocabulary. It is not a native 0.4 Object selector property; native selectors serialize matches_regex.

hive.notes: Hive names are canonical enum values. Case-insensitive source equality is normalized to the canonical enum equality operation; a generic case switch is not exposed.

key.notes: Registry key identity is case-insensitive. The explicit operation remains part of the authored contract so source conversion and native evaluation can preserve intent.

name.notes: Registry value-name identity is case-insensitive. The explicit operation remains part of the authored contract so source conversion and native evaluation can preserve intent.

mount_point.notes: The native contract uses the string selector vocabulary. Source-specific conversion must retain the selected operation and does not infer a broader typed comparison.

unresolved_policy: Every selector in the supported mapping catalog is inventoried by the generator. Selectors without a resolved entry are marked unresolved with their mapping-declared value types and enums; no operator restriction is invented until an owner-reviewed native contract is added.
